domain: University Course Management and Scheduling System
scenario:
A large university is developing an advanced Course Management and Scheduling System to streamline the management of course offerings, scheduling, and instructor assignments. The system will manage detailed course information, including course titles, syllabi, prerequisites, and session schedules. It will handle semester-wise course offerings, allowing for the tracking of changes in course content, instructors, and locations over time.

Instructors will be able to upload and update syllabi and define course requirements and sequences. The system will also facilitate the scheduling of classes, ensuring that no conflicts arise with instructor availability or room bookings. The platform will allow students to view course schedules, locations, and details about course sessions and credits. Additionally, the system should support analytics to monitor course enrollment trends, instructor performance, and room utilization.

The solution must accommodate complex relationships between courses, such as different sessions within a semester, multiple instructors for team-taught courses, and prerequisites for advanced courses. Robust user roles and permissions are required to manage access for administrators, instructors, and students.
